name: column
description: The Wildblood column: three rigs (the Howl, the Slake cart and the hound-runner) that drive a loop of the Scarletwastes from the Deadleg yard to the Slake and up to the North Gate, worked out from the clock. Look only: seats see and hear them through vehicle.contacts as class `column`, and somebody on foot gets a line as they pass. Nothing stored, nothing queried.
